verdict.rationale: Each SKILL.md carries a frontmatter-style description of what the skill does and when to use it. TDD says "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'", grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking", and setup says "Run once before first use". The aihero.dev catalog adds a one-line purpose for each skill, plus a skill-finder skill; skills are installed as readable, editable files and invoked by slash command, which makes behavior predictable. Missing for 10: activation triggers evidenced for only a few of the 25-27 skills (e.g. triage shows no 'use when' clause), no proof that every skill follows the convention, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that the descriptions predict actual agent behavior.
